note: 15 continuous shots. Each shot module renders local frames 1..N (N = round(t1*60)-round(t0*60)). Concat in order = exact song length 295.35s.

shots.desc: memory index page floats in the dark, cursor blinks, slow push
camera falls through fog past lanterns/threads onto the paper stage; a blank sheet sinks past lens
she rises through bubbles holding memory photos; low 28mm track up; starry->cheerful->serious
she lifts a bubble into the past drawer / jar; half orbit 35mm; shy->serious->cheerful
museum hall: table specimen scanned under a cold shaft, then eggplant; her reactions confused/sad/serious then exasperated/cheerful/confused
"I'm searching" interlude: vertical rise through the archive shaft, koinobori kites appear far above, memory % dropping
hall: flower then human hologram; she reaches for the human, her hand passes through the scan
"I'm searching" in the dark: she is alone, only a cold rim; paper dust
forget section: typewriter page, words miss / dope->love, she types over her own memory
chorus storm: paper shards + koinobori fly, she stands in the gale
bridge: bucket of love, shredding paper, shards merge into the paper whale
warm paper sky, the whale swims through drifting sheets; memory: merged
ascent toward the water surface, god rays, koinobori
dawn surface: paper dog / puppy / tomato, the question comes back, memory: ?
